volume.raw_value: 75 µL of 1.0 M ammonium carbonate buffer pH 9.0

composition.raw_value: NP-BAPTES in 2 mL acetonitrile; peptide in 8 mL nanopure water; 75 µL aqueous buffer added

mixture_ratio.raw_value: 2 mL acetonitrile and 8 mL water before 75 µL buffer addition

operation.raw_value: Disperse 10 mg NP-BAPTES in 2 mL acetonitrile in a 4-dram vial.
operation.normalized_value: Disperse 10 mg NP-BAPTES in 2 mL acetonitrile in a 4-dram vial.

operation.raw_value: Dissolve 10 mg peptide in 8 mL nanopure water in a separate 4-dram vial.
operation.normalized_value: Dissolve 10 mg peptide in 8 mL nanopure water in a separate 4-dram vial.

operation.raw_value: Adjust the peptide solution to pH 8.0 by adding 75 µL 1.0 M ammonium carbonate buffer pH 9.0 during water-bath sonication.
operation.normalized_value: Adjust the peptide solution to pH 8.0 by adding 75 µL 1.0 M ammonium carbonate buffer pH 9.0 during water-bath sonication.

operation.raw_value: Add the pH-adjusted peptide solution to the NP dispersion under water-bath sonication.
operation.normalized_value: Add the pH-adjusted peptide solution to the NP dispersion under water-bath sonication.

operation.raw_value: Allow the NP reaction mixture to react under sonication.
operation.normalized_value: Allow the NP reaction mixture to react under sonication.

operation.raw_value: Wash three times with nanopure water by centrifugation at 15,000 × g for 5 min and magnetically isolate to remove unreacted peptide.
operation.normalized_value: Wash three times with nanopure water by centrifugation at 15,000 × g for 5 min and magnetically isolate to remove unreacted peptide.

operation.raw_value: Redisperse the peptide-functionalized NPs in nanopure water at 5 mg/mL.
operation.normalized_value: Redisperse the peptide-functionalized NPs in nanopure water at 5 mg/mL.

original_text.raw_value: 10 mg of NP-BAPTES ... 2 mL of acetonitrile. 10 mg of cTnI-binding peptide (HWQIAYNEHQWQC) ... 8 mL of nanopure water ... adjusted to pH 8.0 by 75 µL of 1.0 M ammonium carbonate buffer pH 9.0 ... react under sonication for 1 h ... washed three times ... centrifugation (15,000 × g, 5 min) ... redispersed ... 5 mg/mL.
original_text.normalized_value: See structured charges and ordered steps.
